name: Box Slopes: Box 0 moves north · 2t at (3, 3, 1)
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 2 ticks after Start.
Box 0: 1 cell, starting at (3, 2, 1); Box 1: 1 cell, starting at (3, 2, 2); Player: 1 cell, starting at (3, 3, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Basalt wall, Blue box slope.

Tick 1: Box 0 moves 1 north; Box 1 moves 1 north; Player moves 1 north.
Tick 2: Box 1 moves 1 west and 1 down.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
